description: Operating override layer. Read-only: the ingest applies these to normalized rows and records income_category, mapping_status, and mapping_note. Source spreadsheets, CSVs, and PDFs are never modified. Tracked in git so dev and prod stay identical and every change is attributable.

incomeRules.note: Broker cash-sweep and settlement interest arrives with no ticker; classify it as interest so it does not sit in the tickerless queue.
